title: Journey Population v0.3: provenance ownership and denominator integrity
summary: Journey Population v0.3 reconciles two valid v0.2 branches by assigning upstream source/sampling/dedup provenance to BrandJourneyPopulation and local time/class/feature/outcome/selection provenance to BrandJourneyCohortDefinition. The analyzer composes both into BrandEvidenceCohortProvenance.
invariants: Unknown upstream facts remain UNSPECIFIED rather than being invented.
Population-owned provenance and cohort-owned provenance are not interchangeable.
Aggregate buckets are indivisible; partial overlap is excluded rather than prorated.
Rejected duplicate attempts are evidence but do not inflate the denominator.
Missing exposed/comparison arms produce analytical INSUFFICIENT or MATERIAL_INVESTIGATION evidence rather than an operational failure.
No path promotes journey association to causation.

provenance.claim: v0.3 provenance ownership reconciliation and API ownership rule.
Population/cohort provenance composition, denominator integrity and statistical boundary.
Cohort-local provenance ownership, legacy cohort configureProvenance and configureSelectionProvenance.
